summary: This is a routine Form 6-K furnishing a press release regarding share purchases by executives under British American Tobacco's HMRC-approved Share Incentive Plan. The CEO and two other persons discharging managerial responsibilities bought nominal numbers of ordinary shares (4, 4, and 3 shares respectively) at £43.99959 per share on the London Stock Exchange on June 3, 2026. No special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring is involved; the filing is a standard notification of insider transactions under UK regulation, mapped to a Form 6-K for SEC purposes.
